jobgether-jobgether:lever:5d2b924e-7f1f-.title: Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5d2b924e-7f1f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Hungary. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf64c66a-9063-.title: Construction Manager/Superintendent
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf64c66a-9063-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Construction Manager/Superintendent based in the United States. This is a senior field leadership opportunity supporting a critical federal aviation infrastructure project focused on runway rehabilitation. You will oversee daily construction operations, coordinate subcontractors, and ensure work is delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with contractual requirements. As the primary field representative, you will work closely with program and project leadership, engineers, government representatives, subcontractors, and other stakeholders. The role requires strong construction expertise across scheduling, quality, safety, cost control, and field coordination. Your leadership will be especially important in an active airfield environment where operational requirements and demanding schedules must be carefully managed. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced construction professional who thrives in complex, high-accountability infrastructure projects. Manage and coordinate all field construction activities associated with the runway rehabilitation project. Direct daily construction operations to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, on schedule, and in accordance with contract requirements. Serve as the primary field representative and coordinate closely with the Program Manager, Project Manager, Site Engineer, subcontractors, government representatives, and project stakeholders. Interface with military personnel, government agencies, utility providers, subcontractors, vendors, and other third parties regarding construction activities. Review construction drawings, specifications, schedules, technical documents, and project requirements to support effective execution. Evaluate constructability and recommend improvements to design elements, sequencing, and field execution. Support subcontractor procurement activities, including bidder list preparation, bid evaluations, and recommendations. Coordinate subcontractor schedules, work plans, quality control plans, safety procedures, labor, equipment, and materials to meet project milestones and airfield operational requirements. Determine material quantities, coordinate deliveries, and manage equipment and workforce resources required for construction activities. Monitor daily labor, equipment, materials, and production quantities to support accurate cost and schedule management. Compare approved budgets with actual costs and productivity factors and communicate relevant findings to program leadership. Identify, document, and support the evaluation of scope changes and potential change order conditions. Assist project management with the review and approval of subcontractor invoices. Conduct health and safety oversight and ensure compliance with applicable company, client, OSHA, EM 385-1-1, and project-specific requirements. Monitor construction progress and proactively resolve field issues affecting schedule, quality, safety, or cost performance. Maintain accurate daily reports, field logs, inspection records, meeting minutes, and other project documentation. Support project closeout, final turnover documentation, and other responsibilities assigned by program leadership. Requirements: 8–12 years of progressively responsible experience in construction management, field supervision, site superintendent, or related construction leadership roles. Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Proven experience managing heavy civil, transportation, aviation, military, paving, infrastructure, or comparable large-scale construction projects. Experience managing runway, airfield, taxiway, concrete, asphalt, grading, or drainage construction is strongly preferred. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e9b15861-87dd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Strategic Financial Analyst based in Canada. This is a high-impact strategic finance role supporting senior leadership across a complex, multi-business organization. You’ll tackle open-ended business questions, bring structure to ambiguity, and turn data into actionable financial insights. The role provides broad exposure to multiple revenue streams, business models, and strategic priorities. You’ll build financial models from the ground up, strengthen forecasting, and investigate the drivers behind business performance. Working directly with senior finance leaders and cross-functional partners, you’ll challenge assumptions and identify risks and opportunities. The position sits at the intersection of strategic finance, data analytics, and business strategy, with meaningful visibility across the organization. It is an ideal opportunity for a curious, analytical finance professional who wants to influence decisions and grow in a fast-paced environment. Take ownership of complex, open-ended financial and business questions spanning multiple functions, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguous problems. Analyze how different business areas generate revenue, identify key growth drivers, and assess the sustainability and quality of business performance. Connect individual business performance to the broader consolidated financial picture and provide insights into trends, opportunities, and risks. Build driver-based financial models, forecasts, and three-statement analyses from the ground up to support strategic decision-making. Identify, access, validate, and analyze the data required to answer business questions, working directly with SQL and BI tools when necessary. Improve in-year and long-range forecasting methodologies by strengthening key drivers, increasing accuracy, and making forecasting processes more efficient and transparent. Own the monthly and quarterly finance rhythm, partnering with business teams on performance reviews, reporting, and financial analysis. Establish and maintain consistent analytical and reporting standards across business areas. Challenge financial assumptions and underlying data while maintaining strong, trusted relationships with business partners. Translate complex financial and operational analysis into clear recommendations for senior finance leaders and business stakeholders. Identify emerging risks and opportunities and proactively communicate their potential impact on business performance and strategic priorities. Strong financial modelling capabilities, including experience building driver-based models and three-statement analyses from scratch. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex questions and identify the underlying drivers behind financial results. Ability to bring structure to ambiguous or previously unowned problems and develop practical, data-driven solutions. Strong business curiosity and intellectual rigor, with a willingness to dig deeply into numbers, challenge assumptions, and understand what is driving performance. Experience working within organizations with multiple revenue streams, business models, products, or operating units. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with both finance and non-finance partners.
